title: open-design: a local, open-source alternative to Anthropic's Claude Design
description:
Anthropic's Claude Design generates production-ready UI on a canvas but it's closed-source, cloud-only, and paywalled. Open-design is the local-first open-source alternative. Plugs into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and local Qwen. 19 design skills, 71 brand-grade design systems. Chat in your terminal, it renders into a sandboxed preview, then exports straight to HTML, PDF, or PowerPoint.

https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design

#github #opensource
